subject: Budget decision & planning: alignment, scenarios, and timeline
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, Apr 3, 2027 at 09:12 AM -07:00
Subject: Budget decision & planning: alignment, scenarios, and timeline

Team —

Kickoff for annual planning and the QBR-oriented budget decisions. I put together a starting timeline and a set of scenario assumptions (attached) that reflect the range of outcomes we've discussed: base, conservative (GDP / sales headwinds), and upside with additional expansion.

Asks / next steps:
- Review the attached "planning_timeline.xlsx" and the scenario assumptions PDF by EOD Monday (Apr 5).
- Confirm owners for: revenue assumptions, headcount & comp, infrastructure cost model, and procurement timing.
- Agree a kickoff meeting slot (60–90m) to align cross-functional inputs and finalize the decision calendar.

Proposed meeting windows: Apr 6 10–11:30 PT or Apr 7 14–15:30 PT. If neither works, flag a preferred time.

Note: we'll need a procurement touchpoint for contract timelines (looping in Acme/ProcureCo where relevant) and a short readout for the exec QBR on Apr 20.

I've attached a lightweight mutual action plan template. Let's keep this tight — the goal is a clear sign-off path for finance by Apr 12 so we can finalize reserve capacity purchases and hiring buckets.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2027-04-03_planning_timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet), scenario_assumptions_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, Apr 3, 2027 at 11:05 AM -07:00
Subject: Re: Budget decision & planning: alignment, scenarios, and timeline

On Sat, Apr 3, 2027 at 9:12 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com> wrote:
> Kickoff for annual planning and the QBR-oriented budget decisions. I put together a starting timeline...

Thanks Rishi — this is a good starting point. A few quick notes: 
- Please include a simple "procurement lead" field on the timeline; we need to show contract lead times for Reserved/Dedicated purchases (Acme and ProcureCo have different buildout SLAs).
- For region-specific forecasts, can someone pull US / EU / APAC revenue split for the last 4 quarters? I'll take US.
- I can host the kickoff on Apr 6 10:00 PT — that works for me. Recommend 90 minutes so we can walk scenarios and the headcount ask end-to-end.

I'll loop in finance contacts at Acme where we may need clarifications on billing cadence; Julie at ZenCloud also flagged potential changes to our marketplace revenue assumptions — I've copied her in the scheduling thread (she's external).

Lauren
Lauren Bishop
VP, Finance Planning & Ops
Redwood Inference

External: Julie Park (zencloud) added for marketplace timing questions.

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, Apr 4, 2027 at 02:20 PM -07:00
Subject: Re: Budget decision & planning: alignment, scenarios, and timeline

Agree with Lauren on the 90m slot. Some scenario-level thoughts to bake into the materials before the kickoff: 
- Downside trigger: 10–12% QoQ ARR shock, delayed enterprise renewals (identify top 5 at-risk accounts) — this should feed immediate hiring freeze triggers and runway-preserving measures.
- Base: our current ops plan with modest efficiency plays (batching + cache improvements) that gives a 6% unit-cost reduction across inference.
- Upside: two product-led expansion plays (embedding search and autosummarize) yielding incremental revenue in H2; model quantization improvements reduce GPU spend by estimated 8%.

Ownership suggestions: 
- Revenue assumptions: Lauren (US), Jonas (EMEA tie-in to Lauren for EU split)
- Headcount & hiring runway: Marissa to propose hires and timing, Karthik to validate FY comp budget impact
- Infra costs: Karthik + Infra cost model (cc infra lead separately)

Also: add a column for "trigger point" on the timeline so execs can see decision gates. I'll prepare a short slide (2–3) on scenario triggers before the meeting.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Chief Strategy Officer (interim)
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, Apr 5, 2027 at 04:43 PM -07:00
Subject: Re: Budget decision & planning: alignment, scenarios, and timeline

Team —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. I've updated the mutual action plan and the timeline (see attached "mutual_action_plan_20270405.docx" and updated spreadsheet). Summary of owners and deadlines: 

- Revenue split & scenario inputs (US / EU / APAC): Lauren — due Apr 7 COB
- Headcount plan & comp buckets: Marissa — draft due Apr 9; final for approval Apr 12
- Infra cost model & quantization assumptions: Karthik — draft Apr 8
- Procurement windows & contract lead time: Rishi to coordinate with Acme / ProcureCo — confirm by Apr 8
- Exec QBR readout (slides + ask): Jonas — draft Apr 13, final Apr 17

Mutual action plan (high level): 
1) Align inputs (Apr 3–9)
2) Consolidate decisions & contingency triggers (Apr 10–13)
3) Finance sign-off & procurement commitments (Apr 12–16)
4) Exec QBR presentation (Apr 17–20)

Please review the attached M.A.P. and comment inline. If any owners above are inaccurate, flag now. If everyone is good, I'll send a calendar invite for the Apr 6 kickoff (90m) with the agenda: scenario review, headcount ask, procurement calendar, and decision gates.

Marissa Cole
Head of People & Planning
Redwood Inference

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_20270405.docx (docx), updated_planning_timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet)
